purpose: Six continuous candidate actions plus wait. NOT a qualified training bank: side defences still leak.
scope_notes: This is an auditable candidate, NOT the requested fully effective training bank. Both side defences currently fail the paired full-window gate.
The three attacks have hit-and-recovery evidence in both physical slots. Upper defence has scheduled pair evidence, not yet unrestricted or learned-policy coverage.
Each skill starts and ends at the same ready vector. No qpos teleport, angle wrapping or clipping is permitted during execution.
Attack region means the defender-local region; defence region means the own-local region. Local left/right coverage differs from physical-slot swapping.
Any adoption of this ready vector must use it equally for A1 and A2 and all three matchup types; never silently transfer old-ready certificates.
Wait/continue is action 0. A busy skill is not an extra PPO decision. Real settled feedback is required before another skill.
The joint table constrains angles. Reference and actual speed reports are diagnostics, not measured motor certification.
All three regions retain the same reward. Whole-blade scoring, neutral weapon contact and approved foul rules remain unchanged.
This small first bank does not claim all historical guards or cut families are complete.
Shared live triangle scoring, seven-ID training interfaces, repeat/transition and A2 continuous-action exploit tests remain required before training admission.

Different-duration A1 skills must not be discounted as equal elapsed time. The training adapter must preserve physical-time reward/discount accounting and exclude busy continuation ticks from independent sampled decisions; A2 uses the same physical episode duration.
